# Stash

> Stash is an investment platform offering brokerage services, investment advisory, and account management through partnerships with Apex Clearing Corporation and other financial entities.

Stash provides retail investment services and maintains comprehensive legal documentation governing customer relationships, account types, and regulatory compliance. The platform operates through multiple corporate entities including Stash Investments LLC and Stash Capital LLC.

## Key Topics

- Stash Investments LLC
- Apex Clearing Corporation
- Stash Capital LLC
- Brokerage Account
- Investment Adviser
- Customer Agreement
- Legal Terms
- Account Conversion
- Federal Law
- Account Management

## Legal Agreements & Terms

- [Apex Customer Agreement](https://www.stash.com/apexcustomeragreement): Legal customer agreement between Stash and Apex Clearing Corporation governing brokerage account terms and conditions
